content_text: There is always a place where you want your mid exposure to fall. Here it would be the sink counter top. Another example would be a wall which you want to read as a stop under. While I have to admit it is easier to shoot a scene like this with a calibrated monitor to refer to, the viewing conditions when you look at the monitor can be deceptive. That is why a meter is always a good tool.
